title: Shadow Pilot Owner Workload Matrix (PASS 42)
honesty: This matrix records the STRUCTURAL workload behaviour the harness proves (one clear next step, server-computed payload, no re-keying of supported output, delegation where safe). It does NOT claim a measured owner time-saving — a truthful workload-reduction number requires a real owner in the loop and is recorded by the owner in OWNER_SHADOW_PILOT_RESULTS_TEMPLATE.md. No fabricated owner-time-savings.

perScenario.ownerFacingLoad: one reassessment step + a missing-data ask
approve/decline a discount once margin is measured
approve a quality correction; training/SOP routed to manager/staff
delegate recurring firefighting to a manager + set a policy
collect capacity/cost data; opportunity stays blocked (no owner outreach)
one survival triage action (stop-loss + protect cash) first

structuralClaims: exactly one top action per scenario (bridge topRoute single) — no decision overload
the cockpit reads a server-computed payload; the owner does not re-key data OpsIQ already holds
delegation routes (MANAGER/STAFF) reduce owner load where safe; owner-only material actions cannot be delegated
clean/missing-data adds no load (no fabricated task)
notClaimed: a measured owner time-saving in hours/percent (needs a real owner; recorded manually)
